title: Preserve repository filters during exact staging
failure_signature: The first exact staged review found seventeen content-seal mismatches and diff-check failures because a command-local core.autocrlf=false override staged CRLF bytes instead of the repository's normalized LF blobs.
trigger_preconditions: Content seal used repository-filtered Git blob semantics
Restaging disabled the repository line-ending filter for one command
candidate_workaround: Restage the exact file set with repository-default filters, retain recurring conversion warnings under N08, verify all staged blobs are LF, then rerun the exact review without changing host configuration.
recurrence_guard: Do not override repository clean filters when the manifest or content seal is defined over repository-filtered Git blobs.
rollback: Replace only the candidate index entries by restaging the same owned files through repository-default filters; do not alter working-tree content, Git configuration, history, or sibling state.
scope_boundary: This method addresses staged newline and seal parity only and proves no scientific, privacy, security, accessibility, identity, authority, or independent-reproduction claim.
